name: corsair
description: Connect your users to their apps
one_liner: Infrastructure that lets an app or AI agent securely connect to a user's other accounts, like Gmail or Slack, without building that login plumbing yourself.
buyer: A founder building an AI automation product who needs users to connect their Google Calendar, Slack, or CRM without months of OAuth integration work.
business_use_cases: An AI scheduling assistant startup lets users connect their Google Calendar in one click instead of building OAuth flows for a dozen providers themselves.
A no-code AI agent builder platform offers "connect your apps" as a built-in feature to compete with larger platforms.
An internal tools team adds one-click connections to company SaaS accounts for employee-facing automations.

money_ideas.idea: Charge per connected account, the standard model for this category of infrastructure.
Offer tiered subscription plans based on number of supported app integrations.

steal_this: If you're already building an AI SaaS product, wire this in this weekend to ship a "connect your apps" onboarding flow instead of building OAuth integrations yourself.
